purpose: Reviewable inventory of QuickFurno internal templates and their PLANNED WhatsApp Cloud API mappings. This is NOT an API submission and grants NO approval. Every entry stays approval_status='draft' with provider_template_name=null and provider_template_id=null. Phase 5F-B adds binding_contract READINESS ONLY where the source keys are proven from repository call sites; it submits no template and creates no mapping row.
warnings: No template here is submitted or approved.
No secrets, tokens, or real OTP examples are stored.
body_spec placeholders use {{n}} positional variables; actual approved copy is defined at submission time.
provider_template_id remains null until Meta assigns one after approval.
binding_contract.binding_readiness='resolved' only where source_key is proven in repository code; 'unresolved' entries are NOT guessed.

binding_contract_notes.proof: The only CommunicationIntent variable built by live callers is { otp } (services/supabaseSendSmsHookService.ts, services/vendorVerificationService.ts, services/vendorPasswordResetService.ts). Business-template source keys are not wired to any live caller, so their bindings remain unresolved.
binding_contract_notes.component_semantics: component + 1-based position <- source_key (parameter_type). Positions are deterministic; order is NEVER inferred from object key order.
